title: Maps, Tilesets & Scene Background Projection
objective: Use MAI/ARI maps, tile families, Scene renders or bounded map crops as panel-background presentation references while preserving map, Scene, ARI and source-domain ownership boundaries and without starting later SAA staging/export authority.
acceptance: Background projection consumes governed map, tileset, tile-family, Scene-render or bounded-map-crop references rather than copying canonical map or Scene truth into SAA.
Each projected background preserves source identity, provenance/version references and applicable rights/use-capability references.
Bounded crop/viewport state is presentation-only and does not mutate canonical map geometry, tile topology, Scene placement or source resources.
Map/tile/Scene compatibility and unsupported or unavailable source states remain explicit and fail closed instead of fabricating coverage.
Projection can bind a governed background reference to SAA page/panel composition while preserving SAA-02 panel geometry and SAA-03 composition boundaries.
Keyboard/textual equivalents can inspect, choose and bind background projections without requiring drag gestures.
Provider-off local operation is supported for locally available governed sources; optional AI and paid cloud are not required.
Later SAA staging, lettering, export/share/publication and SMB10B authority remain unauthorized.
boundaries: MAI/map owners retain canonical map/tile/geometry authority; Scene retains canonical scene composition/placement/live-state authority; ARI retains resource identity/provenance/rights authority.
SAA-07 creates panel-background presentation projections only and may not mutate map, Scene, ARI or other source-domain truth.
No silent fallback from unavailable map/Scene sources to fabricated backgrounds.
No export/share/publication or final Creator integration authority is granted.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-07.
